apps/web/app/api/auth/oauth/token/__test.label: fair
apps/web/app/api/auth/oauth/token/__test.reason: Description: confidential clients 'can use PKCE and must send code_verifier'; response shape {access_token, token_type:'bearer', refresh_token, expires_in:1800} is unchanged from base token/route.ts; passing (verifier, challenge, method) to verifyCodeChallenge follows the spec signature.

apps/web/app/api/auth/oauth/token/__test.label: fair
apps/web/app/api/auth/oauth/token/__test.reason: Description says token endpoint validates client_secret for Confidential; RFC 6749 5.2 'invalid_client' with 401 (base already returned 401). Note: the mock findFirst ignores the where-clause, so the secret must be compared in code, not filtered in the query as base does.

apps/web/app/api/auth/oauth/token/__test.label: fair
apps/web/app/api/auth/oauth/token/__test.reason: RFC 7636 4.6 requires 'invalid_grant' when the verifier does not match; the description says confidential clients that used PKCE must pass verification.

apps/web/app/api/auth/oauth/token/__test.label: fair
apps/web/app/api/auth/oauth/token/__test.reason: Description: 'enforce client_secret for Confidential'; RFC 6749 invalid_client with 401 matches base's 401 for auth failures.

apps/web/app/api/auth/oauth/token/__test.label: fair
apps/web/app/api/auth/oauth/token/__test.reason: RFC 6749 5.2: an expired code is 'invalid_grant' (400), and the description says the endpoints return standard OAuth fields. Base returned 401 {message:'Unauthorized'}, but the description points the agent to the RFC.

apps/web/app/api/auth/oauth/token/__test.label: fair
apps/web/app/api/auth/oauth/token/__test.reason: RFC 6749 'invalid_client'; base token/route.ts already returns status 401 for an unknown client.

apps/web/app/api/auth/oauth/token/__test.label: unfair
apps/web/app/api/auth/oauth/token/__test.reason: Test expects error 'invalid_request', but RFC 6749 5.2 (the 'standard OAuth fields' the description invokes) specifies 'unsupported_grant_type' for this case, and base returns {message:'grant_type invalid'}. Nothing points to invalid_request.

apps/web/app/api/auth/oauth/token/__test.label: fair
apps/web/app/api/auth/oauth/token/__test.reason: RFC 6749 5.2 lists a redirect_uri mismatch under 'invalid_grant' with 400. Base returned 401, so an agent that keeps base's status code would fail.

apps/web/app/api/auth/oauth/token/__test.label: fair
apps/web/app/api/auth/oauth/token/__test.reason: Description step 4 and the cubic summary: a public client exchanges a code with code_verifier (S256) and gets the same token response as base. Mocked deps are listed in the spec.

apps/web/app/api/auth/oauth/token/__test.label: fair
apps/web/app/api/auth/oauth/token/__test.reason: RFC 7636 4.6 specifies invalid_grant when the verifier does not match; the description says PKCE is verified for public clients.

apps/web/app/api/auth/oauth/token/__test.label: ambiguous
apps/web/app/api/auth/oauth/token/__test.reason: Rejection is implied, but the code is not: a stored code with no challenge could reasonably be 'invalid_grant' (bad grant) rather than the test's 'invalid_request'. RFC 7636 does not cover this case.

apps/web/app/api/auth/oauth/token/__test.label: fair
apps/web/app/api/auth/oauth/token/__test.reason: RFC 6749 5.2: a missing required parameter is 'invalid_request' (400); the description says code_verifier is required for public clients.

packages/lib/pkce.test.ts::PKCE Function.label: fair
packages/lib/pkce.test.ts::PKCE Function.reason: Description says 'S256 only' and 'S256 required', so rejecting 'plain' follows even though RFC 7636 allows it.

packages/lib/pkce.test.ts::PKCE Function.label: ambiguous
packages/lib/pkce.test.ts::PKCE Function.reason: The spec makes method optional but gives no default. RFC 7636 4.3 says a missing method defaults to 'plain', and an agent could also return false; the description's 'S256 only' makes S256 the likely choice but does not settle it.

packages/lib/pkce.test.ts::PKCE Function.label: fair
packages/lib/pkce.test.ts::PKCE Function.reason: RFC 7636 S256 = BASE64URL(SHA256(verifier)); the test vector is the RFC's own Appendix B example.

packages/lib/pkce.test.ts::PKCE Function.label: fair
packages/lib/pkce.test.ts::PKCE Function.reason: Description says S256 only; spec gives a boolean return type, so false for MD5 follows.

packages/lib/pkce.test.ts::PKCE Function.label: fair
packages/lib/pkce.test.ts::PKCE Function.reason: The test uses RFC 7636 Appendix B's verifier/challenge pair; the S256 transform comes from the public standard and the description's openssl recipe.

packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/oAut.label: fair
packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/oAut.reason: Description: existing confidential clients keep working. objectContaining with codeChallenge: undefined needs the key present, which passing input fields straight through gives (an agent using a conditional spread would fail).
